.github/FUNDING.yml.summary: This configuration file defines financial support platforms for project sponsorship. It has no exported functions or classes and facilitates community funding on GitHub.

.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.summary: This file defines the project's community standards and behavioral guidelines based on the Contributor Covenant. It establishes rules for inclusive participation and outlines enforcement responsibilities for maintainers.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug-report.yml.summary: This YAML file defines the GitHub issue template for reporting bugs (`Bug Report`). It standardizes user bug submissions by collecting descriptions, reproduction steps, and diagnostic checklists for the project.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature-request.y.summary: This GitHub issue template file standardizes user feature requests. It acts as a project configuration form for new enhancements.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml.summary: This file configures GitHub issue templates for the project by disabling blank issues and providing direct links to discussion categories for questions and troubleshooting.

.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md.summary: This source file provides a standardized Markdown template for GitHub pull requests. It guides contributors to document changes, purposes, and related issues, ensuring consistent code review metadata across the project.

.github/workflows/build-and-test.yml.summary: This GitHub Actions workflow automates the CI pipeline by building and testing the project with Maven on JDK 11 whenever code is pushed to or PR'd against `master`.

.github/workflows/make-release.yml.summary: This GitHub Actions workflow automates the project release process by building the application JAR via Maven and publishing it as a draft release.

README.md.summary: This `README.md` file documents the JMusicBot fork, detailing setup instructions, updated dependencies, and added features. It serves as the primary project guide and overview for self-hosting.

docs/fork-changelog.md.summary: `docs/fork-changelog.md` documents fork-specific features, bug fixes, and configuration updates across releases. It serves as a high-level changelog for operators and contributors.

docs/setup.md.summary: This Markdown documentation file provides non-Docker installation, configuration, and execution instructions for the project. It outlines prerequisites, Discord bot setup, and essential configuration properties.

docs/docker.md.summary: This file is a Markdown documentation guide (`docs/docker.md`) that explains how to deploy and configure the bot using Docker and Docker Compose. It serves as the primary reference for containerized deployment, volume mounting, and persistent configuration.
